name: Howard M. Srebnick
tagline: Top rated White Collar Crimes attorney in Miami, Florida
about: Howard M. Srebnick is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. He works at Black Srebnick, located in Miami, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Criminal Defense: White Collar, Appellate and Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Howard Srebnick completed legal studies at Georgetown University Law Center and graduated with the class of 1989. Howard Srebnick passed the bar in 1989.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
